headline: Race eve, and the plan is carrying you now rather than the data - the last file you have is Sunday the 13th.
body:
Nothing has synced since **17 Sep 17:20** - training.json is **38.7 hours old** this morning, and the watch under it has been silent since **13 September**: four null wellness rows against 35 unbroken before them, and two more days the file does not even reach. Yesterday's spin and the drive are unrecorded, not missed. There is no file to be silent with.

Today, exactly as written: **15 min jog** at **131-150 bpm, 6:45-7:15/km** - slower than it wants to be. Then **10 min** at Santos: swim out, sight the exit twice, land where you will land tomorrow. It is a look at the water, not a test. Registration 11:30-16:30 at Diaz Strand, bike checked, **off your feet by 16:00**.

I have no Mossel Bay forecast - weather.json is Cape Town and stops on 17 September - so the sea call today is yours on the beach.

Charge the watch and force a sync before tonight. And the ankle - how is it? This is the last morning an answer changes anything.
